command_line:
set -eu
{
  echo '--- full cromwell find ---'
  find / -iname '*cromwell*' -o -iname '*caper*' 2>/dev/null | head -200
  echo '--- full java jars ---'
  find / -name '*.jar' 2>/dev/null | head -200
  echo '--- pip download test ---'
  python3 -m pip download --no-deps --dest "$PWD/pipdl" caper==1.3.0 >/tmp/pip.log 2>&1 || true
  cat /tmp/pip.log | tail -50
  ls -la "$PWD/pipdl" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo '--- curl google ---'
  curl -I -L -sS --max-time 10 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ENCODE-DCC/caper/master/README.md >/tmp/curl.out 2>&1 || true
  head -30 /tmp/curl.out
  echo '--- resolve ---'
  getent hosts pypi.org || true
  getent hosts raw.githubusercontent.com || true
  echo '--- apt cache ---'
  ls -la /var/cache/apt/archives 2>/dev/null | head || true
  echo '--- java11 ---'
  ls -la /usr/lib/jvm 2>/dev/null || true
} > net_find.txt
